    Your MOT, part by part.

    MOT testing, servicing and repairs on Cecil Street. 5.0 from 220 Google reviews

  2. Through the bay door

    Onto the lane.

    Ten of the things an MOT checks, lit up one at a time.What is checked: gov.uk

  3. Check 1 of 10

    Lights

    Condition, operation and headlamp aim.

    On our wall: “Headlamp testing area. Keep clear.”

  4. Check 2 of 10

    Wipers and washers

    That they work properly, so you have a clear view of the road.

  5. Check 3 of 10

    Horn

    That it works properly and suits the vehicle.

  6. Check 4 of 10

    Seatbelts

    In place, in good condition, working properly and attached securely.

  7. Check 5 of 10

    Tyres and wheels

    Condition, security, size and type, and tread depth.

  8. Check 6 of 10, on the rollers

    Brakes

    Condition, operation and performance. The wheels stay on.

  9. Check 7 of 10, up on the lift

    Steering and suspension

    Their condition, and that they work correctly.

  10. Check 8 of 10

    Exhaust and emissions

    Secure, complete, no serious leaks, not too noisy, and inside the emissions rules.

    On our sign: “Diesels tested. Catalysts tested.”

  11. Check 9 of 10

    Body and structure

    Free from excessive corrosion or damage, with no sharp edges.

  12. Check 10 of 10

    Number plates and VIN

    Plates in good condition, secure, the right colour, characters correctly formed and spaced. A single VIN on show.

  13. Sheet ticked.

    MOT CHECK SHEETExample
    1. Lights
    2. Wipers
    3. Horn
    4. Seatbelts
    5. Tyres
    6. Brakes
    7. Steering
    8. Exhaust
    9. Body
    10. Plates
    PASS

    Anything to keep an eye on goes down as an advisory.

When's your MOT due?

Put in the date from your last certificate. It works it out on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere.

From gov.uk: you can get an MOT up to a month (minus a day) before it runs out and keep the same renewal date. A new car needs its first MOT by the third anniversary of its registration.
